finding_summary: DIVE empty CSV cells are recognized as unknown during folderization, but only positives create symlinks; the downstream folder-membership parser therefore serializes the lost unknown state as zero.
limitations: Category-level transformation evidence; does not identify every protected contract-class cell whose zero originated from an empty CSV cell.

finding_summary: DIVE has no canonical CallToUnknown mapping; DIVE-only rows therefore carry historical zero for this class absent another source positive.
limitations: Unsupported source coverage is not negative evidence about the contract.

finding_summary: DIVE Bad Randomness is deliberately absent from the canonical class map; an exclusively Bad-Randomness assertion can therefore become an all-zero historical target after crosswalk loss.
limitations: 634 Bad Randomness files are known; the exact exclusive-only protected subset is unavailable remotely.

finding_summary: SmartBugs categories short_addresses and other map to NonVulnerable, producing an all-zero ten-class target; one-category parsing also serializes all non-target classes as zero.
limitations: Mapping to NonVulnerable does not establish ten independently reviewed class negatives.

finding_summary: SolidiFI proves the injected class positive but the parser emits zero for all nine non-target classes even though the injection corpus has no ten-class negative-control authority.
limitations: Category-level source semantics; contract-specific injected positives still require retained contract-class evidence for confirmation.

finding_summary: The June 13 historical audit records 2,655 protected-target rows where DenialOfService was directly changed from 1 to 0 when Reentrancy was also positive.
limitations: The historical audit proves the mutation occurred; it does not by itself prove each patched DoS outcome is truly negative.

finding_summary: Labels/split rows without representation shards remain in historical row counts but are omitted from the ML dataset because SentinelDataset filters split IDs against the shard index.
limitations: Representation absence changes ML eligibility/population, not vulnerability truth.

finding_summary: The historical ML interface carries only a ten-cell target tensor and no per-class target mask; AsymmetricLoss therefore applies negative loss to every historical zero that reaches training.
limitations: This establishes training semantics, not the correct R4 outcome for any particular contract-class pair.
